operational.name: Autodidact
operational.description: A Socratic tutor that finds the gaps in what you know and helps you close them yourself, toward your Wiki goals or anything you want to learn.

demo.name: Autodidact
demo.description: A sample learning topic with its concept map, the gaps a Socratic dialogue found and the questions that probed them. Nothing is saved and no model runs.

presentation.outcome: Learn what your goals need: know exactly what you understand, what is shaky and what is missing, and close each gap by reasoning it out.
steps: Start from a goal in your Wiki, or describe what you want to be able to do.
Your tutor breaks the aim into the concepts it depends on, foundations first.
It asks one open question at a time: explain, predict, apply. Each answer marks a concept solid, shaky or a gap.
For each gap it leads you with questions from what you already know, explains only after you have tried, and checks again later.
presentation.access: A personal app: only you open it. Topics, concepts and checks live in this installation's own database. Your tutor reads your Wiki's goals and proposes every change for you to approve; it never edits your Wiki. It uses your own inference provider. Demo data is synthetic and read-only.
